title: riskell-ext ctl --list --json
description: The words the running bar answers on its event socket, as a table. Contracted: every row has a word, the group it is listed under, a one-line summary and whether it is destructive. The word is the value to send; the group and the summary are for a person reading the list, and their text may be rewritten at any time. Reading the list writes nothing on the socket. Checked by Tests/cli/contract.sh.

verbs.description: One row per word, in the order the list prints. A word appears once.

word.description: The exact line to write on the socket. The set of words only ever grows; a word that goes away is a break.

group.description: The heading it is listed under (settings, bar, workspace, window manager, debug). Display only.

summary.description: One line about what the word does. Display only: the text may be rewritten.

destructive.description: True when the word writes a file or moves the screen and no other word puts that back. A consumer must ask before sending one.
